column1: # Planted faults for the settable generator options (qrcode-symbologies.md, Public API direction).
# ro-*: `readonly` taken off a hand-written getter. new-*: a member added without it. Both make the compiler copy the struct
# when it is read through `in`. init-*: an option back on an init accessor. mask-*: a MaskPattern bound one step loose.
# clobber-* and offset-*: a setter that writes another member, or the value where the offset from the default belongs.
# The two shipping projects enforce code style when they build, so ro-* and new-* stop at IDE0251 and the run reports
# BUILD FAILED, as it does for init-*, where the assignment tests no longer compile. To see which test catches ro-* and
# new-* without the analyzer, put a Directory.Build.rsp holding -p:EnforceCodeStyleInBuild=false in the repository root
# for the run and delete it afterwards.
# Against the full suite (2026-10-10) all 19 are refused. ro-* and new-* fail the build with IDE0251, and with code style off
# SettableStruct_EveryMemberButASetterIsReadOnly catches each of them, alone for all but new-pair. init-qr-kanji fails the build
# of the tests. The rest are caught by GeneratorOptionsAssignmentTest, among others.
